description: This PHP class defines an AWS SDK client for interacting with the CloudWatch Observability Access Manager (OAM) service, including method signatures for various OAM operations.

classes.name: OAMClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS CloudWatch Observability Access Manager service, providing methods for managing links, sinks, and policies.

methods.name: createLink
methods.description: Creates a new CloudWatch Observability Access Management link.

methods.name: createLinkAsync
methods.description: Async version for creating a new link.

methods.name: createSink
methods.description: Creates a new sink in CloudWatch OAM.

methods.name: createSinkAsync
methods.description: Async version for creating a sink.

methods.name: deleteLink
methods.description: Deletes an existing link.

methods.name: deleteLinkAsync
methods.description: Async version for deleting a link.

methods.name: deleteSink
methods.description: Deletes a sink.

methods.name: deleteSinkAsync
methods.description: Async version for deleting a sink.

methods.name: getLink
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific link.

methods.name: getLinkAsync
methods.description: Async version for retrieving link details.

methods.name: getSink
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific sink.

methods.name: getSinkAsync
methods.description: Async version for retrieving sink details.

methods.name: getSinkPolicy
methods.description: Gets the policy associated with a sink.

methods.name: getSinkPolicyAsync
methods.description: Async version for getting sink policy.

methods.name: listAttachedLinks
methods.description: Lists links attached to a resource.

methods.name: listAttachedLinksAsync
methods.description: Async version for listing attached links.

methods.name: listLinks
methods.description: Lists all links.

methods.name: listLinksAsync
methods.description: Async version for listing links.

methods.name: listSinks
methods.description: Lists all sinks.

methods.name: listSinksAsync
methods.description: Async version for listing sinks.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Async version for listing tags.

methods.name: putSinkPolicy
methods.description: Sets the policy for a sink.

methods.name: putSinkPolicyAsync
methods.description: Async version for setting sink policy.

methods.name: tagResource
methods.description: Tags a resource.

methods.name: tagResourceAsync
methods.description: Async version for tagging a resource.

methods.name: untagResource
methods.description: Removes tags from a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Async version for untagging.

methods.name: updateLink
methods.description: Updates an existing link.

methods.name: updateLinkAsync
methods.description: Async version for updating a link.
